verdictEs: Wiki.gg si quieres saber 'qué hace este legend' o 'cómo funciona esta mecánica' — cobertura enciclopédica del juego. Liquipedia si te interesa el competitive scene: tournaments ALGS, pro players, rosters de teams, prize pools y formato de leagues.
verdictEn: Wiki.gg if you want to know 'what does this legend do' or 'how does this mechanic work' — encyclopedic game coverage. Liquipedia if you're interested in the competitive scene: ALGS tournaments, pro players, team rosters, prize pools, and league formats.

useCases.labelEs: Lookup edge cases de ability mechanics
useCases.reasonEs: Wiki.gg tiene pages dedicadas a cada ability con notas de interaction, patch history y community testing. Liquipedia tiene pages de legends pero foco competitive — menos detalle en edge cases.
useCases.reasonEn: Wiki.gg has dedicated per-ability pages with interaction notes, patch history, and community testing. Liquipedia has legend pages but with competitive focus — less edge-case detail.

useCases.labelEs: Verificar historial career de un pro player
useCases.labelEn: Verify a pro player's career history
useCases.reasonEs: Liquipedia tiene player pages con career timeline cross-team, earnings, tournament results. Wiki.gg no cubre player profiles competitive.
useCases.reasonEn: Liquipedia has player pages with cross-team career timeline, earnings, tournament results. Wiki.gg doesn't cover competitive player profiles.

useCases.labelEs: Stats de weapons con damage tables
useCases.reasonEs: Wiki.gg tiene weapon stat tables comparativas (damage por body part, mag size, reload time). Liquipedia cubre weapons pero más superficial sin tables comprehensive.
useCases.reasonEn: Wiki.gg has comparative weapon stat tables (damage per body part, mag size, reload time). Liquipedia covers weapons but more superficially without comprehensive tables.

useCases.labelEs: ALGS tournament history y prize pools
useCases.labelEn: ALGS tournament history and prize pools
useCases.reasonEs: Liquipedia es THE archive de ALGS — bracket de cada season, prize pool distribution, results detallados. Wiki.gg no cubre esports.
useCases.reasonEn: Liquipedia is THE ALGS archive — per-season bracket, prize pool distribution, detailed results. Wiki.gg doesn't cover esports.

useCases.labelEs: Lore deep-dive de legends y faction backstory
useCases.reasonEs: Wiki.gg tiene secciones de lore con character backstories, faction timelines, Apex Games narrative. Liquipedia ignora completamente lore.
useCases.reasonEn: Wiki.gg has lore sections with character backstories, faction timelines, Apex Games narrative. Liquipedia ignores lore entirely.
